Given the lack of best-practice for preprocessing raw data for data integration, we assessed whether integration methods perform bet - ter with HVG selection or scaling. Comparing the performance between integration runs that only differed in one preprocessing parameter, we found that HVG selection generally outperformed data integration of the full gene set across RNA and simulation tasks: for HVGs, 74% of comparisons had a higher overall score; 81% had better batch removal and 66% had better bio-conservation scores.
